external_data.name: UK Civil Aviation Authority, Punctuality statistics, full analysis (arrival / departure) CSV, per month

files.2025: twelve monthly files, hashes in docs/caa_heathrow/verification.json

external_data.columns_used: reporting_airport (HEATHROW), arrival_departure (D), airline_name, origin_destination, scheduled_charter, number_flights_matched, average_delay_mins
external_data.terms: page statement: 'No statistical data provided by CAA may be sold on to a third party. CAA insists that they are referenced in any publication that makes reference to CAA Statistics.' No open licence named on the page.
external_data.nature: per airport, airline, origin/destination and month: the number of matched flights and their average departure delay in whole minutes, delay = actual off-block minus the planned gate time, early flights counted as zero, cargo / positioning / private movements excluded. In 2025 the published mean equals the mean of max(off-block - schedule, 0) from the supplied clocks within the minute rounding in 58-87% of groups per month (rounding alone gives 100% within half a minute only when centred), with an offset of 0.10-0.44 minutes (published higher) and a robust sd of 0.34-0.43 minutes across groups (rounding alone: 0.29). It is an aggregate of the hidden off-block clock of the ranking rows at Heathrow. No official score and no leaderboard information is used.

procedure.code: src/prc2026_caa/heathrow.py (implied mean, shrinkage, shift), tools/run_caa_heathrow.py (groups, offsets, months, export)
procedure.mapping: docs/caa_heathrow/destinations.csv (204 CAA destination names to ICAO codes by name and 2025 monthly counts, 95.6% of the published departures), docs/caa_heathrow/airlines.csv (67 callsign prefixes to CAA airline names by 2025 counts per destination-month)
procedure.summary: per Heathrow airline x destination group of the month whose published count is at least 30 and agrees with our count within max(2, 3%): the group's implied mean of max(delay, 0) under the row error (delay = schedule interval minus prediction, normal row error with the class sd) plus the definitional offset, against the published mean; the level error is clipped to +-2 minutes; its noise is the rounding variance (1/12 min^2) plus the row noise (sd^2 / n) plus the definitional noise; the group biases' variance is the month's own dispersion of the level errors beyond their noise (empirical Bayes, label-free, at least 0.01 min^2); the shrunk correction is applied as one taxi shift per group, solved so that the group's implied mean drops by the correction; rows predicted at 10,800 s or more keep their value; floor -12 s; every other row keeps the base
procedure.fitting_side: the class row-error sd (matched / unmatched) from v48's residuals at Heathrow in the other development months; the definitional offset and noise from the labels of the other months of 2025 (docs/caa_heathrow/verification.json)
procedure.base: v48's procedure (the daily totals) applied first; this layer moves Heathrow rows only
procedure.free_parameters: none fitted on scores or on the scored months

development_read.control: v48's procedure on the v46 development stack (runs/daily_totals/daily_totals_v1/<month>.parquet)
development_read.reading: RMSE of the complete month (every airport) with the Heathrow rows replaced, against the control; the paired-day 95% interval; the Heathrow-only change; a placebo that reads the published figures of another 2025 month (month + 6)

rule.text: no equal-footing month worse than the control and the mean improvement over the equal-footing months at least 0.01% of RMSE; November reported only; the paired-day intervals and the placebo are reported, not part of the rule (the expected change is below what a month's days can resolve)

exploration_disclosed.ceiling: on the four development months, with v48's values, the airline x destination group-level part of Heathrow's squared error beyond the noise floor is 0.75-1.25% of Heathrow's squared error (0.05-0.13% of the month's); docs/adsb_coverage/sources_20260930.md section 2
exploration_disclosed.verification: docs/caa_heathrow/verification.json (labels of 2025 against the published figures; no prediction involved)
exploration_disclosed.nothing_else: no variant of the procedure was scored before this declaration
